model_annotation: The chart illustrates the training set quantity, validation set quantity, and accuracy rate across five different recognition and reasoning tasks. The horizontal axis displays the categories: 实体识别, 角色识别, 异常识别, 空间推理, and 同义识别. The chart features dual vertical value axes without explicit titles. The primary left vertical axis, corresponding to the bar quantities, uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1200 with tick intervals of 200. The secondary right vertical axis, corresponding to the line graph, uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1 with tick intervals of 0.1. The data is presented using grouped vertical bars alongside an overlaid line graph. According to the legend at the top, blue bars represent 训练集数量 (Training set quantity), orange bars represent 验证集数量 (Validation set quantity), and the grey line represents 准确率 (Accuracy rate). Within each category, the blue bar is positioned to the left of the orange bar. Every bar and line point is explicitly annotated with its exact numerical value. For the blue bars, values range from a minimum of 5 for 同义识别 to a maximum of 1210 for 空间推理, with other values being 1102 (实体识别), 1095 (角色识别), and 1077 (异常识别). For the orange bars, values range from a minimum of 40 for 异常识别 to a maximum of 675 for 空间推理, with other values being 250 (实体识别), 190 (角色识别), and 55 (同义识别). The grey line connects data points representing accuracy, with annotated values of 0.7666, 0.8714, 0.692, 0.2852, and 0.3769 across the respective categories from left to right. The categories on the horizontal axis do not follow a strict ascending or descending numerical sort. The primary visual emphasis is the inclusion of exact numerical data labels above each bar and adjacent to each point on the line graph, supported by horizontal grid lines corresponding to the primary left y-axis ticks.
